ethics_rules: No mess that someone else has to clean up
No embarrassment in front of other people
Stop immediately if the person asks you to
Never prank strangers or anyone who hasn't agreed to be pranked
Never waste food or other resources

pranks.title: Googly Eyes on Everything
pranks.description: Stick googly eyes on items in the fridge, on fruit, on shampoo bottles. Watch faces light up when they open the fridge.
steps: Buy a pack of stick-on googly eyes
Place pairs of eyes on food packaging, eggs, milk carton, soap
Leave them and wait for someone to find them

pranks.title: Upside Down Room
pranks.description: Flip lightweight things upside down in your sibling's room. Picture frames, books on shelf, stuffed animals. Nothing breaks, nothing moves out of place.
steps: Wait until they leave their room
Carefully flip frames, books, plushies upside down
Leave the room exactly as you found it otherwise

pranks.title: The Frozen Cereal Bowl
pranks.description: Pour their usual cereal and milk the night before, then freeze it. In the morning hand them a 'breakfast' that won't budge.
steps: Ask them what cereal they want for breakfast
Make the bowl with milk the night before
Place in freezer overnight
Hand it to them with a spoon in the morning

pranks.title: Voice-Activated Faucet
pranks.description: Tell them the kitchen faucet was upgraded to voice control and they have to say 'water on, please' to make it work.
steps: Mention casually that the faucet is now voice-activated
Demonstrate by saying the phrase as you turn the handle subtly
Watch them try it later

pranks.title: Tiny Cereal Box
pranks.description: Make a miniature version of the family cereal box and put it in the cabinet next to the real one.
steps: Print or draw a tiny version of the cereal box label
Build a mini box from cardboard
Place it on the shelf in front of the real box

pranks.title: Backwards Day
pranks.description: Wear your shirt backwards all morning until someone notices, then act surprised.
steps: Put your shirt on backwards in the morning
Act normally
When someone points it out, gasp and say 'How did THAT happen?'

pranks.title: Ceiling Spider
pranks.description: Tape a paper spider to the ceiling above their desk. Only do this if your sibling thinks bugs are funny, never if they're scared of them.
steps: First check: would this scare them? If yes, skip this prank
Cut a spider shape from black paper
Tape to ceiling above their study spot
Wait for them to look up

pranks.title: Auto-Correct My Name
pranks.description: Add a keyboard shortcut on their phone so 'hi' auto-expands into a long silly greeting. Tell them within an hour so they can undo it.
steps: Get permission to borrow their phone for a minute
Go to Settings, Keyboard, Text Replacement
Add: shortcut 'hi' expands to 'Greetings honored human, what a fine day'
Tell them about it after they've used it once

pranks.title: Fake Spilled Milk
pranks.description: Make a fake puddle of spilled milk from glue and place it next to a tipped-over (empty) cup.
steps: Pour white glue in a milk-puddle shape onto wax paper
Let dry overnight until it peels off
Place on table next to a tipped-over empty cup
Reveal the trick within 30 seconds of them seeing it

pranks.title: Bubble Wrap Welcome
pranks.description: Hide bubble wrap under the rug at the front door. Pop pop pop when they walk in.
steps: Lift the entryway rug
Spread bubble wrap underneath
Replace the rug
Wait for the popping sounds

pranks.title: The Long Letter
pranks.description: Write a 4-page handwritten letter that builds up dramatically and ends with 'made you read all this'.
steps: Write a long story about something exciting that happened
On the last page reveal it was just a prank to make them read
Slip under their door

pranks.title: Wrong Day of the Week
pranks.description: Tell everyone in the morning that today is the wrong day of the week and act surprised when they correct you.
steps: At breakfast say 'Happy Wednesday everyone!' (when it's actually Tuesday)
Insist for a moment, then laugh

pranks.title: Frozen Toothbrush
pranks.description: With permission to borrow it, freeze your sibling's toothbrush in a cup of water. Hand it to them at bedtime.
steps: Take the toothbrush early in the day
Place in cup of water in freezer
Hand to them at brushing time, then immediately offer their real one

pranks.title: Mystery Sock Pile
pranks.description: Hide a clean rolled-up sock in 10 different normal places. Watch them slowly find them all week.
steps: Take 10 clean rolled socks from your own drawer
Hide one in the fridge, one in a shoe, one in the cereal box, etc.
Tell them at the end of the week how many they missed

pranks.title: Pet Rock Surprise
pranks.description: Wrap a rock with a face drawn on it as a 'surprise gift'. Build up a lot of excitement first.
steps: Find a smooth rock outside
Draw a friendly face on it
Wrap it carefully like a real present
Hand it over with a big speech about how special it is

pranks.title: Whoopee Cushion Classic
pranks.description: The original. Place the whoopee cushion under a couch cushion right before they sit down.
steps: Inflate the whoopee cushion
Slip under their favorite seat cushion
Wait

pranks.title: Drawer Confetti (One Piece)
pranks.description: Place a single tiny piece of paper that says 'BOO' inside their pencil drawer. Minimal mess, big surprise.
steps: Cut a small square of paper
Write 'BOO' or a smiley on it
Tape inside their drawer so they see it when they open it

pranks.title: The Wrong Picture Frame
pranks.description: Print out a picture of a celebrity or cartoon character and slip it inside an existing photo frame.
steps: Print a silly photo at the same size as the frame
Carefully open the frame and put the new photo on top
Reassemble and put back
Tell them within a day so they know it's swapped

pranks.title: Mismatched Shoes
pranks.description: Swap one of their shoes with one from a different pair, but keep the matching pair nearby so they're not late.
steps: Take one shoe and replace with a different shoe (also their own)
Watch them notice
Make sure they have time to fix it before leaving

pranks.title: The Compliment Ambush
pranks.description: A 'reverse prank' - sneak up on someone and give them an over-the-top compliment.
steps: Pick someone who deserves cheering up
Run up and shout 'AMBUSHED! You're amazing at math!'
Run away dramatically

pranks.title: Robot Voice Question
pranks.description: For one whole conversation, only respond in robot voice. Start a normal chat, then never break character.
steps: Start a normal conversation
Switch to robot voice for every response
Keep going until they laugh or ask you to stop

pranks.title: Stuffed Animal Ambush
pranks.description: Arrange all their stuffed animals around their bed having a meeting.
steps: Gather every plushie you can find
Arrange them in a circle on their bed like they're chatting
Optional: leave a tiny note in the middle reading 'meeting in progress'

pranks.title: Reverse Bedroom
pranks.description: Carefully turn lightweight things in their room to face the wall. Picture frames, books, etc.
steps: While they're out, turn frames to face the wall
Turn books spine-in
Make sure to put everything back the way it was after they see it

pranks.title: Salt the Sugar Bowl
pranks.description: Only do this on yourself or with someone who already knows it's coming - never secretly. Swap the contents and act surprised at your own coffee.
steps: Tell your family in advance you're doing a self-prank
Swap sugar with salt in your own bowl only
React dramatically to your own breakfast

pranks.title: The Faulty Remote
pranks.description: Put a small sticky note over the remote's sensor. The remote 'breaks'. Reveal within 60 seconds.
steps: Cut a tiny piece of sticky note
Place over the front sensor of the remote
Watch them press buttons in confusion
Reveal quickly so no one gets frustrated

pranks.title: Grape in the Cherry Tomato Bowl
pranks.description: Sneak a single green grape into a bowl of cherry tomatoes. Watch the face when someone bites it.
steps: Wash a green grape
Tuck it into the cherry tomato bowl
Wait for the surprise crunch

pranks.title: Tomato in the Grapes
pranks.description: Same idea, reversed. A cherry tomato hiding in the grape bunch.
steps: Wash a small cherry tomato
Set it among the grapes
Pretend not to know anything

pranks.title: The Overly Polite Day
pranks.description: Be EXTREMELY polite all day. Bow when handing things over. Say 'I do humbly request the cereal' instead of 'pass the cereal'.
steps: Decide on a fancy old-timey way of speaking
Use it for every interaction
Bow occasionally

pranks.title: Door Sign Prank
pranks.description: Put a 'Wet Paint' or 'Out of Order' sign on something completely normal, like the cereal cabinet.
steps: Make a serious-looking sign that says 'CEREAL CABINET OUT OF ORDER'
Tape to the cabinet door
Wait for someone to read it and laugh

pranks.title: Pretend I Can't Hear
pranks.description: Pretend you suddenly can't hear them at all but can hear everyone else. Cup ear, look confused.
steps: When sibling speaks, look totally puzzled
Respond normally to others
Reveal after a couple of minutes - never let them feel ignored

pranks.title: The Ice Cream Cone of Mashed Potatoes
pranks.description: Serve mashed potatoes scooped on top of an ice cream cone like dessert. Reveal it's actually dinner.
steps: Make mashed potatoes (or use leftovers)
Scoop into a cone shape on top of an ice cream cone
Hand over with great excitement about 'dessert before dinner'

pranks.title: Wallpaper a Door in Wrapping Paper
pranks.description: Cover their bedroom door entirely in wrapping paper using removable tape only. Easy cleanup, big visual reveal.
steps: Use only painter's tape (removable, won't damage paint)
Cover the outside of their door in wrapping paper
Help take it down afterwards

pranks.title: Drawer Switcheroo
pranks.description: Swap the contents of two of their drawers - socks become shirts, etc. Help them put it back after.
steps: Pick two drawers with similar-sized clothes
Carefully swap the contents
Be ready to help return it to normal

pranks.title: Fake Phone Ring
pranks.description: Mimic a phone ringing perfectly. Watch parents check their pocket. Reveal quickly.
steps: Practice a convincing ringtone with your voice
Make the sound from another room
Step out laughing before they search too long

pranks.title: The Loud Whisper
pranks.description: Have a normal conversation but at maximum volume. Then a normal-volume conversation in a tiny whisper.
steps: Walk up and SHOUT 'HELLO HOW ARE YOU TODAY'
Then drop to a whisper for everything else
Switch back without warning

pranks.title: Costume Lunch Drop-off
pranks.description: Only with a sibling who would think this is funny - greet them at the door from school in a silly hat.
steps: Check first that this won't embarrass them in front of friends
Wait by the door in a goofy hat
Greet them like nothing is unusual

pranks.title: Mystery Smoothie
pranks.description: Make a smoothie with strange but completely safe and edible combinations. Spinach + banana + pickle juice. Reveal ingredients after they brave a sip.
steps: Check for any food allergies first
Use only safe edible ingredients - no soap, no anything weird
Offer one small sip
Reveal the ingredients and have a normal smoothie ready as backup

pranks.title: I'm a Statue
pranks.description: Freeze in a strange pose somewhere people will pass and refuse to move or react.
steps: Pick a hallway
Strike a dramatic pose - one foot up, finger pointing somewhere
Hold completely still until someone asks what you're doing

pranks.title: Backwards Walking Day
pranks.description: Walk backwards everywhere you go for an hour. Refuse to acknowledge anything is unusual.
steps: Walk to breakfast backwards
Walk to your room backwards
Look surprised when someone points it out

pranks.title: Hidden Disco
pranks.description: Hide a small bluetooth speaker in their room. Play one second of disco music every few minutes. Reveal within an hour.
steps: Hide a small speaker behind a book on their shelf
From another room, play a 1-second disco clip
Wait a few minutes, do it again
Reveal the speaker so they know it's not a haunting

pranks.title: The Frozen Greeting
pranks.description: When someone walks into the room, freeze mid-action like you've been paused. Stay frozen until they laugh.
steps: Be doing something normal like reading
When they enter, freeze with the page half-turned
Don't blink, don't move

pranks.title: Magic Coin
pranks.description: Learn a simple coin disappear trick from a video. Show off all day until they figure it out.
steps: Watch a beginner coin trick tutorial
Practice a few times
Perform whenever you walk past your sibling

pranks.title: The Fancy Restaurant
pranks.description: Set the dinner table fancy and act as a snobby waiter all evening. Bring real dinner to the table on a tray.
steps: Tell parents you're hosting tonight
Drape a napkin over your arm
Use a fake fancy accent and offer a 'menu'

pranks.title: Photobomb the Family Photos
pranks.description: Cut out a small picture of your face and tape it onto a stick. Add it just behind a family photo on the shelf.
steps: Print a small selfie
Glue to a popsicle stick
Stand it behind a photo frame so just your head peeks over

pranks.title: The Rubber Band Sprayer
pranks.description: DO NOT do this to anyone else - water can damage phones, ruin clothes, and stress people out. The classic version (rubber band on the kitchen sprayer) is included here only as an example of what NOT to do.
steps: Skip this one
Try a different prank instead

pranks.title: Pretend I'm Asleep Standing Up
pranks.description: Stand in a doorway with your eyes closed and snore quietly. When people approach, just keep snoring.
steps: Stand somewhere people pass
Close eyes, snore softly
Don't move when they say your name

pranks.title: Wrong Light Switch Labels
pranks.description: Label every light switch with what it 'really' does. Like 'Summons aliens' or 'Activates dragon mode'.
steps: Cut small sticky notes
Write silly purposes on each
Stick under each switch in the house

pranks.title: The Imaginary Friend
pranks.description: Introduce your family to your new imaginary friend named Bartholomew the Pickle.
steps: Walk around with an empty arm crooked like you're holding hands
Say things like 'Bartholomew says hi'
Insist on setting a place for him at dinner

pranks.title: Yes Day Reverse
pranks.description: Agree enthusiastically with EVERYTHING your sibling says, even contradictions. 'You should clean your room.' 'YES!' 'You should not clean your room.' 'YES!'
steps: Pick 30 minutes to be ultra-agreeable
Say YES to everything with enthusiasm
Reveal the prank if they get confused

pranks.title: The Long Knock-Knock
pranks.description: Tell a knock-knock joke that has 30 'who's there' rounds before the punchline. Drag it out as long as possible.
steps: Start: 'Knock knock'
Each time they say 'who's there', say 'BANANA' for ten rounds
Then switch to 'ORANGE' for the punchline: 'Orange you glad I didn't say banana?'

pranks.title: Encyclopedia Cover for Comic Book
pranks.description: Make a fake serious-looking textbook cover for a comic book. Read 'studiously' next to your parent.
steps: Wrap a comic in paper
Write a fancy title like 'Advanced Calculus Volume IV'
Read it with extreme concentration

pranks.title: Paper Cup Maze
pranks.description: Set up dozens of empty paper cups in a path through a hallway so people have to step around them. Help collect them after.
steps: Use empty disposable cups only - no liquid
Arrange them through a non-essential hallway
Be present to help collect them right after the reveal

pranks.title: Slow Motion Day
pranks.description: Move in extreme slow motion. Take 30 seconds to lift a fork. Take 60 seconds to walk five steps.
steps: Pick a 10-minute window
Move everything in slow motion
Speak in a low slow voice too

pranks.title: Mystery Object
pranks.description: Place a totally random object in a place where it doesn't belong. A spoon on the bookshelf. A toy car in the salad.
steps: Pick something safe and clean
Tuck it somewhere unusual
Wait to see how long it takes to be noticed

pranks.title: Operation Stealth Sticker
pranks.description: Stick a single small sticker on the back of your sibling. See how long it takes them to find it.
steps: Pick a fun sticker
Wait for a hug or a back-pat moment
Stick gently on their back
Tell them after lunch if they haven't noticed

pranks.title: Ceiling Note
pranks.description: Put a sticky note on the ceiling above their bed that says 'Why are you looking up?'
steps: Stand on a chair safely
Stick a note on the ceiling above their pillow
Wait for them to lie down and find it

pranks.title: Fake Cake
pranks.description: Frost a clean kitchen sponge to look like a slice of cake. Offer it on a plate. Have a real treat ready as a follow-up.
steps: Use a brand-new clean sponge
Cover with safe frosting (don't let anyone actually eat it)
Reveal before any bite is taken
Bring out the real cake or fruit immediately

pranks.title: Pet Translator
pranks.description: Pretend to translate everything the family pet (or a plushie) is saying. Make it dramatic.
steps: Sit by the pet
Listen intently
Translate: 'She says she demands more treats and respect'

pranks.title: Lego Instructions
pranks.description: Make a fake instruction manual for a 'new' Lego set. The instructions get sillier with every step.
steps: Draw step 1: 2 normal bricks
Step 2: connect them
Step 5: now build a rocket. Step 6: launch to Mars

pranks.title: I Forgot How to Sit
pranks.description: Approach a chair and act like you've forgotten how to use it. Try sitting upside down, sideways, on the back.
steps: Stare at the chair confused
Try sitting in increasingly silly ways
Eventually 'figure it out' triumphantly

pranks.title: Echo
pranks.description: Repeat exactly what your sibling says. Stop the moment they ask you to.
steps: Repeat their words quietly after them
Match their tone
STOP IMMEDIATELY when asked - no exceptions

pranks.title: The Inventor
pranks.description: Tape two random objects together and present them as your latest invention with a serious explanation.
steps: Tape a spoon to a stuffed animal
Call a family meeting
Explain it solves a problem nobody has

pranks.title: Whisper Secret Messages to Plants
pranks.description: Walk up to houseplants and whisper into them. When asked what you're doing, say 'They needed an update.'
steps: Approach a plant seriously
Whisper for 30 seconds
Walk away as if it was very important

pranks.title: Reverse Greeting
pranks.description: Say 'goodbye' instead of 'hello' and 'good night' instead of 'good morning' for an entire morning.
steps: When you see family members, say 'goodbye!'
Stay in character
Eventually let them in on the joke

pranks.title: Fake Snow Globe
pranks.description: Make a snow globe with a tiny family member figurine inside. 'You're trapped in there!'
steps: Glue a small figure to the jar lid
Fill jar with water and add a pinch of glitter
Seal tight
Give as a 'gift'

pranks.title: Cardboard Cereal Box
pranks.description: Refill an empty cereal box with crumpled paper. Reveal immediately when they pour - have actual cereal ready.
steps: Use an actually empty box
Stuff with crumpled clean paper
Watch them grab it
Reveal before they tip it over the bowl

pranks.title: Pretend to Find Treasure
pranks.description: Pretend to dig in the couch cushions and 'discover' something amazing. A button. A grape. Hold it up like it's gold.
steps: Dig theatrically into cushions
Gasp loudly
Hold up a button: 'WE'RE RICH!'

pranks.title: Soap Doesn't Lather
pranks.description: Skip this one too - leaving someone with un-clean hands isn't fair. Listed only as an example of an unfair prank.
steps: Skip - try a different prank

pranks.title: The Secret Handshake
pranks.description: Insist that the family has a new official secret handshake. Make it 30 steps long. Make everyone learn it.
steps: Make up an absurdly long handshake
Insist on doing it before every meal
Add a step every day

pranks.title: Pretend the WiFi Has Personality
pranks.description: Talk to the WiFi router like it's a grumpy coworker. 'Come on Greg, we talked about this.'
steps: Walk past the router
Have a one-sided conversation with it
Thank it whenever the internet works

pranks.title: Loud Sound Effects
pranks.description: Make sound effects for everything you do. Walking: BOING. Sitting: WHOOSH. Picking up cup: ZOINK.
steps: Pick a 10-minute window
Add a sound effect to every action
Don't break character

pranks.title: Pretend to Be a Tour Guide
pranks.description: Lead a serious house tour for your family as if they've never seen it. 'And to our left, the famous refrigerator...'
steps: Make a paper megaphone
Gather the family
Tour them through their own house with detailed history

pranks.title: Tiny Notes in Pockets
pranks.description: Slip a tiny encouraging or silly note into each of their coat pockets. They find them throughout the day.
steps: Write small notes: 'You look great today!' or 'BANANA'
Slip into each coat pocket
They discover them on their own

pranks.title: The Reading Out Loud
pranks.description: Read the back of a cereal box out loud as if it's the most riveting story ever told. Use a Shakespearean voice.
steps: Pick up any nutritional info
Read it like a dramatic monologue
'AND LO! TWELVE GRAMS OF SUGAR!'

pranks.title: Reverse Hide and Seek
pranks.description: Hide somewhere extremely obvious like under a clear table. See how long it takes them to find you.
steps: Announce 'I'm hiding!'
Pick the worst hiding spot possible
Whisper 'shhh' to anyone who walks by

pranks.title: Singing Conversations
pranks.description: Sing every sentence in opera style for 15 minutes. Pass the saaaaaalt pleeeeeease.
steps: Pick 15 minutes
Sing every word
Bonus points for hitting high notes

pranks.title: The Family Newspaper
pranks.description: Create a fake newspaper with absurd headlines about your family. 'DAD DISCOVERS NEW SOCK ARRANGEMENT'
steps: Write headlines and short funny articles
Add a weather forecast for the kitchen
Slip under bedroom doors

pranks.title: Pretend to Find a Genie
pranks.description: Rub a teapot dramatically and pretend a genie has come out. Offer wishes to your family. The genie misunderstands every wish hilariously.
steps: Rub a teapot
Speak as the genie
Whatever they wish for, give a silly wrong version

pranks.title: Pasta Necklace Gift
pranks.description: Make a giant pasta necklace. Present it to a family member with extreme seriousness as if it's a royal honor.
steps: String dry pasta on a string
Bow as you present it
Insist they wear it for one full meal

pranks.title: Air Drumming Forever
pranks.description: Air drum at extremely intense levels to whatever music is playing, even if it's quiet background music.
steps: Wait for any music
Air drum like you're at a concert
Add air guitar at the chorus

pranks.title: Chair Swap
pranks.description: Swap everyone's usual seats at the dinner table before they sit down.
steps: Move chairs to different positions
Or rearrange place settings
Watch them stand confused

pranks.title: Talking to a Banana Phone
pranks.description: Hold a banana to your ear and have a serious phone conversation with it. Hand the banana to a family member: 'It's for you.'
steps: Pick up a banana
Pretend to take a call
Pass the banana to someone with a serious nod

pranks.title: I Speak A New Language
pranks.description: For 5 minutes, only speak in made-up gibberish. Act surprised that no one understands you.
steps: Speak only in nonsense syllables
Look hurt when they don't understand
Reveal: 'Oh, you don't speak Floogle?'

pranks.title: The Long-Awaited Surprise
pranks.description: Build up huge excitement about a surprise inside a wrapped box. The reveal: a single grape.
steps: Wrap a small box with one grape inside
Talk it up all morning
Reveal with maximum drama

pranks.title: Backwards Sentences
pranks.description: Say every sentence in reverse word order. 'Cereal more want I.' Insist this is the new family rule.
steps: Speak only in reverse word order
Insist it's a new tradition
Drop it after 5 minutes

pranks.title: Fake News Anchor
pranks.description: Become a serious news anchor reporting on what's happening in the house. 'Breaking news: dad has located the remote.'
steps: Hold a paper as your script
Use a serious news voice
Report on every household event

pranks.title: Sticky-Note Storm
pranks.description: Cover one item in their room (not everything) in sticky notes. Just their lamp, or just their mirror.
steps: Pick ONE item to cover
Use only sticky notes (no permanent damage)
Help collect them after the reveal

pranks.title: Pretend the Floor is Lava
pranks.description: Refuse to step on the floor for 15 minutes. Hop from couch to chair to ottoman.
steps: Announce solemnly: 'The floor is lava'
Move only by hopping on furniture
Beg family for rescue

pranks.title: I Lost My Pencil (in My Hand)
pranks.description: Hold a pencil in your hand and search frantically for it everywhere.
steps: Hold pencil clearly visible in your hand
Loudly ask everyone where your pencil could be
Eventually 'discover' it

pranks.title: Hat in a Hat
pranks.description: Wear five hats stacked on your head. Walk around acting normal.
steps: Find every hat in the house
Wear them all at once
Refuse to acknowledge anything is unusual

pranks.title: Pretend to Read Their Mind
pranks.description: Loudly announce what your sibling is 'thinking' - all silly things. 'You're thinking about how much you love broccoli.'
steps: Stare intensely at your sibling
Proclaim: 'I sense you crave more chores!'
Get sillier each time

pranks.title: Magnetic Hand
pranks.description: Pretend your hand is magnetically attracted to your face. Fight it with the other hand.
steps: Slowly pull your hand toward your face
Fight against it with your other hand
Lose the battle dramatically

pranks.title: Wrong Lyrics All Day
pranks.description: Sing the wrong lyrics to every song that comes on. With total confidence.
steps: Listen to family playlist
Sing made-up wrong words
Insist those are the real lyrics

pranks.title: I Am Now A Cat
pranks.description: Be a cat for ten minutes. Only respond in meows. Sit on things. Knock a (soft, unbreakable) item off a table.
steps: Crouch and meow
Slowly push a stuffed animal off the couch
Stare into space

pranks.title: Hide All The Pens
pranks.description: Hide every visible pen in one drawer (not lose them - just relocate). Reveal location within 30 minutes if needed.
steps: Gather all loose pens
Stash them in one specific drawer
Tell parent the location if they actually need to write something

pranks.title: Rate-Your-Day Survey
pranks.description: Hand each family member a serious-looking customer satisfaction survey about their day. Include questions like 'rate your dinner conversation 1-10'.
steps: Write a survey form
Include silly serious questions
Collect at the end of the night with great formality

pranks.title: Wrap an Object in Foil
pranks.description: Wrap one item from their room in aluminum foil. Just one - their pencil cup, their mouse, their water bottle.
steps: Pick ONE non-electronic item
Wrap it neatly in foil
Help unwrap after they discover it

pranks.title: The Time Travel Story
pranks.description: Run in breathlessly and announce you've just come back from the future. Give absurd predictions like 'In 4 years, dogs will run the post office.'
steps: Burst in panting
Share dramatic absurd 'future news'
Refuse to explain how you traveled

pranks.title: Compliment Battle
pranks.description: The reverse-prank classic. Ambush family members with overwhelming compliments until they smile.
steps: Pick a target
Hit them with three rapid-fire compliments
Run before they can respond

pranks.title: April Fool the Calendar
pranks.description: Stick a note on the family calendar marking today as a made-up holiday. 'NATIONAL WEAR-A-SOCK-ON-YOUR-HEAD DAY'
steps: Pick a silly holiday
Write it on a sticky note
Add to today's date on the calendar
Insist on observing it

pranks.title: Surprise Rubber duck
pranks.description: Tuck a rubber duck in the fridge behind the milk. See how long it takes someone to spot it.
steps: Find a clean rubber duck you don't mind being moved.
Place it in the fridge behind the milk when nobody is looking.
Pretend not to know anything when it's discovered.

pranks.title: Surprise Tiny plastic dinosaur
pranks.description: Tuck a tiny plastic dinosaur on top of the bathroom mirror. See how long it takes someone to spot it.
steps: Find a clean tiny plastic dinosaur you don't mind being moved.
Place it on top of the bathroom mirror when nobody is looking.
Pretend not to know anything when it's discovered.

pranks.title: Surprise Small toy car
pranks.description: Tuck a small toy car on the top shelf of the pantry. See how long it takes someone to spot it.
steps: Find a clean small toy car you don't mind being moved.
Place it on the top shelf of the pantry when nobody is looking.
Pretend not to know anything when it's discovered.

pranks.title: Surprise Googly-eyed potato
pranks.description: Tuck a googly-eyed potato behind a picture frame. See how long it takes someone to spot it.
steps: Find a clean googly-eyed potato you don't mind being moved.
Place it behind a picture frame when nobody is looking.
Pretend not to know anything when it's discovered.

pranks.title: Surprise Sock puppet
pranks.description: Tuck a sock puppet next to the toothbrushes. See how long it takes someone to spot it.
steps: Find a clean sock puppet you don't mind being moved.
Place it next to the toothbrushes when nobody is looking.
Pretend not to know anything when it's discovered.

pranks.title: Surprise Stuffed frog
pranks.description: Tuck a stuffed frog in the fridge behind the milk. See how long it takes someone to spot it.
steps: Find a clean stuffed frog you don't mind being moved.
Place it in the fridge behind the milk when nobody is looking.
